description: Adds a document to a DRAFT signature request. Requires: signature_request_create → requestId, case_file_create → caseFileId. Provide a string `id` for the document. Compute SHA-256 hex hash of the PDF before calling. Optional: pass `fileUrl` (a publicly accessible URL) to have the tool download and upload the file to S3 automatically — no separate PUT needed. If fileUrl is omitted, returns url (presigned S3 upload URL) for manual PUT. Cannot add documents after activate_signature_request is called. For CONFIGURABLE sequence: `groupId` must reference a Document type group (not Signatory or DocumentSignatory) — passing a wrong group type returns 'Signature group not found'.

convertToPdf.description: Convert non-PDF to PDF before processing

fileUrl.description: Optional public URL to download and auto-upload the PDF to S3. Eliminates the manual PUT step.

groupId.description: For CONFIGURABLE sequence: ID of a Document type group

hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the PDF content (64 hex chars)

id.description: UUID for the document — becomes documentId for coordinate_set and certificate_get

name: signature_request_add_document
